Here’s what a solid offer needs to have and look like.

- **Opening \-** Who It’s for \- Digging into certain pain points they are actively struggling within their business. 

  Painting a picture about where they’re currently sitting in their biz & the struggles of being there. 

- **Results Snapshot \-** Tie in your own results / Client results \- the closer you can tie these to the product you’re selling or the strategies taught inside of what you’re selling the better

  If you don’t have your own leverage community results & results of people inside of the program (creators and students) 

- **Highlight benefits of the program \-** Not the features of your product but how it will solve the problem & thing you dug into at the beginning of the doc

  Speak about the “feeling” or place they’ll be once they’ve implemented the product. 

  If you can highlight the benefits of the program while “eliminating” a certain thing it can be very powerful. 

  How we did with GJ & the without cold dm’s strat or even how MIF does with the No selling yourself..   
    
- **Transition into Core features of your product \-** break down the different features of the product & what those will bring to your clients biz.

  IE \- On Day one you’ll learn how to build out your business so you can effectively grow & monetize, giving you the ability to make money online through free social media content vs On day one we’ll show you how to build an online business. 

- **Transition into Bonuses \-** 

- **Briefly dig into the pain point & transition into solution/product with a credibility statement (can be a few sentences)** 

- **Availability \- Spots / Days Left to get in or a combination of the two** 

- **Pricing (One time or payment plan)**

- **Wrap up \- Either prompt to hit the check out inside doc or have them follow back up with you**
